KEY_ERF_CONFLICT.meaning: The cadastre draws this parcel key in pieces that carry different erf numbers, so the key is quarantined and the linker abstains before looking at candidates (candidates.py:8, parcel.erf_conflict).
KEY_ERF_CONFLICT.en: The survey map gives this parcel conflicting erf numbers, so it was not matched.
KEY_ERF_CONFLICT.af: Die opmetingskaart gee teenstrydige erfnommers vir hierdie erf, dus is dit nie gekoppel nie.

NO_CANDIDATE.meaning: No roll row in the parcel's municipality has this erf number (as whole erf, remainder or sectional parent).
NO_CANDIDATE.en: No roll entry with this erf number was found in this municipality.
NO_CANDIDATE.af: Geen rolinskrywing met hierdie erfnommer is in hierdie munisipaliteit gevind nie.

ROLL_COVERAGE:{n}%.meaning: Share of this SG town's parcels that have any full-title roll candidate; emitted with NO_CANDIDATE — >=50% gives not_in_roll, <50% gives abstain.
ROLL_COVERAGE:{n}%.en: The roll has entries for {n}% of parcels in this town.
ROLL_COVERAGE:{n}%.af: Die rol het inskrywings vir {n}% van die erwe in hierdie dorp.

ROLL_COVERAGE:?.meaning: Literal fallback when the town's roll coverage is unknown (no coverage row for the town code); always with NO_CANDIDATE and decision abstain.
ROLL_COVERAGE:?.en: We could not tell how much of this town the roll covers.
ROLL_COVERAGE:?.af: Ons kon nie bepaal hoeveel van hierdie dorp die rol dek nie.

PORTION_ROWS:{n}.meaning: {n} roll rows are numbered sub-portions of this erf (via 'erf_portion'); the map draws only the remainder, so they are named but never matched.
PORTION_ROWS:{n}.en: {n} roll entries are numbered portions of this erf, not the parcel drawn on the map.
PORTION_ROWS:{n}.af: {n} rolinskrywings is genommerde gedeeltes van hierdie erf, nie die erf wat op die kaart geteken is nie.

TOWN_A.meaning: The leading candidate's suburb/town label maps to this parcel's SG town at tier A (by name, manual approval, or erf-number distribution and Stats SA agreeing).
TOWN_A.en: The best-fitting roll entry's place name clearly corresponds to this parcel's town.
TOWN_A.af: Die bes passende rolinskrywing se pleknaam stem duidelik ooreen met hierdie erf se dorp.

TOWN_B.meaning: The leading candidate's locality label maps to this town at tier B: one strong statistical signal (erf-number distribution >=97% of >=50 erven, or Stats SA) but no name confirmation.
TOWN_B.en: The best-fitting roll entry's place name probably corresponds to this town, based on statistics, not the name.
TOWN_B.af: Die bes passende rolinskrywing se pleknaam stem waarskynlik ooreen met hierdie dorp, volgens statistiek, nie die naam nie.

TOWN_C.meaning: The leading candidate's locality label maps to this town at tier C: a weaker erf-number-distribution signal (>=95% of >=20 erven) only.
TOWN_C.en: There is only weak evidence that the best-fitting roll entry's place name belongs to this town.
TOWN_C.af: Daar is net swak bewyse dat die bes passende rolinskrywing se pleknaam by hierdie dorp hoort.

TOWN_SPAN.meaning: The leading candidate's locality label overlaps this town (shares some erven, or an ambiguous name) but this town is not its home.
TOWN_SPAN.en: The best-fitting roll entry's place name only partly overlaps this town, so the town is unconfirmed.
TOWN_SPAN.af: Die bes passende rolinskrywing se pleknaam oorvleuel net gedeeltelik met hierdie dorp; die dorp is onbevestig.

TOWN_NONE.meaning: The leading candidate's locality labels are unreliable or carry no crosswalk evidence for any town.
TOWN_NONE.en: The best-fitting roll entry gives no usable place name, so its town is unconfirmed.
TOWN_NONE.af: Die bes passende rolinskrywing gee geen bruikbare pleknaam nie, dus is sy dorp onbevestig.

TOWN_CONTRA.meaning: Every candidate's locality label maps (A/B/C) only to other SG towns — the best evidence contradicts this parcel; decision abstain.
TOWN_CONTRA.en: Every roll entry with this erf number names a different town, so none was matched.
TOWN_CONTRA.af: Elke rolinskrywing met hierdie erfnommer noem 'n ander dorp, dus is geeneen gekoppel nie.

TOWN_CONFLICT.meaning: The best candidate's locality evidence is self-contradictory (label name and erf numbers disagree, or the row's town and suburb labels disagree); decision abstain.
TOWN_CONFLICT.en: The roll entry's place details contradict each other, so it was not matched.
TOWN_CONFLICT.af: Die rolinskrywing se plekbesonderhede weerspreek mekaar, dus is dit nie gekoppel nie.

CONTRA_GROUPS:{n}.meaning: {n} candidate groups (same erf number) have locality labels that map only to other towns; they are rejected and never listed.
CONTRA_GROUPS:{n}.en: {n} other roll entries share this erf number but belong to other towns; they were set aside.
CONTRA_GROUPS:{n}.af: {n} ander rolinskrywings deel hierdie erfnommer, maar hoort by ander dorpe; hulle is eenkant gesit.

CONFLICT_GROUPS:{n}.meaning: {n} candidate groups carry self-contradictory locality evidence (name vs numbers, or town vs suburb label).
CONFLICT_GROUPS:{n}.en: {n} roll entries with this erf number have contradictory place details and were set aside.
CONFLICT_GROUPS:{n}.af: {n} rolinskrywings met hierdie erfnommer het teenstrydige plekbesonderhede en is eenkant gesit.

DATE_AFTER_ROLL.meaning: The parcel (status S/A) was registered after the leading roll's cycle start (1 July of the cycle year), so the row may describe the pre-subdivision land; vetoes acceptance.
DATE_AFTER_ROLL.en: This parcel was registered after the roll was compiled, so the roll entry may describe older boundaries.
DATE_AFTER_ROLL.af: Hierdie erf is geregistreer nadat die rol opgestel is, dus beskryf die rolinskrywing dalk ouer grense.

AREA_MIXED.meaning: The parcel is drawn in several pieces with different registration statuses, so its area is not summed and not used as evidence.
AREA_MIXED.en: This parcel is mapped in pieces of different status, so its size could not be compared.
AREA_MIXED.af: Hierdie erf is in stukke met verskillende status gekarteer, dus kon sy grootte nie vergelyk word nie.

AREA_ROLL_UNRELIABLE.meaning: The leading row's roll has an extent column that does not consistently measure the surveyed area (median absolute deviation > 0.3 in log10), so area is treated as unknown.
AREA_ROLL_UNRELIABLE.en: This roll's recorded sizes are unreliable, so size was not used to check the match.
AREA_ROLL_UNRELIABLE.af: Hierdie rol se aangetekende groottes is onbetroubaar, dus is grootte nie gebruik om die passing na te gaan nie.

AREA_UNKNOWN.meaning: No area comparison was possible: no single leading full-title row, a sectional scheme, missing roll extent or SG area, or an unreliable roll.
AREA_UNKNOWN.en: The size of the roll entry could not be compared with the mapped parcel.
AREA_UNKNOWN.af: Die grootte van die rolinskrywing kon nie met die gekarteerde erf vergelyk word nie.

AREA_NOT_USED.meaning: An area ratio exists but the parcel is AREA_MIXED, so the comparison is deliberately ignored.
AREA_NOT_USED.en: A size comparison was possible but deliberately not used, because the parcel is mapped in mixed pieces.
AREA_NOT_USED.af: 'n Groottevergelyking was moontlik, maar is doelbewus nie gebruik nie, omdat die erf in gemengde stukke gekarteer is.

AREA_OK.meaning: The leading row's roll extent (unit-corrected) agrees with the SG parcel area within |log10 ratio| <= 0.1 (about ±26%).
AREA_OK.en: The roll entry's recorded size agrees with the mapped parcel's size.
AREA_OK.af: Die rolinskrywing se aangetekende grootte stem ooreen met die gekarteerde erf se grootte.

AREA_WEAK.meaning: The roll extent and SG area differ by a factor between about 1.26 and 5 (0.1 < |log10 ratio| <= 0.7).
AREA_WEAK.en: The roll entry's recorded size only roughly matches the mapped parcel's size.
AREA_WEAK.af: Die rolinskrywing se aangetekende grootte pas net rofweg by die gekarteerde erf se grootte.

AREA_CONFLICT.meaning: The roll extent and SG area differ by more than about 5x (|log10 ratio| > 0.7); vetoes acceptance and caps confidence at 0.6.
AREA_CONFLICT.en: The roll entry's recorded size is very different from the mapped parcel's size.
AREA_CONFLICT.af: Die rolinskrywing se aangetekende grootte verskil baie van die gekarteerde erf se grootte.

MULTI_GROUP:{n}.meaning: {n} candidate groups tie at the top evidence level and cannot be separated; decision ambiguous.
MULTI_GROUP:{n}.en: {n} roll entries fit this parcel equally well and cannot be told apart.
MULTI_GROUP:{n}.af: {n} rolinskrywings pas ewe goed by hierdie erf en kan nie onderskei word nie.

SCHEME_GROUP.meaning: The single tier-A leading group is a sectional-title scheme (units whose parent erf is this parcel); decision accepted_group.
SCHEME_GROUP.en: The matching entries are sectional-title units in a scheme built on this parcel.
SCHEME_GROUP.af: Die passende inskrywings is deeltiteleenhede in 'n skema wat op hierdie erf gebou is.

SCHEME_PARENT_R0.meaning: A full-title row valued R0/NULL (or a register 'parent' row) sharing this erf was identified as the scheme's land parcel and merged into the accepted scheme group.
SCHEME_PARENT_R0.en: The erf itself is listed on the roll at R0; the scheme's units carry the values.
SCHEME_PARENT_R0.af: Die erf self is teen R0 op die rol gelys; die skema se eenhede dra die waardes.

UNIQUE_MUNI.meaning: The erf number exists in only one SG town of the municipality and the roll has only one full-title row for it; with tier B town and matching area this alone allows accepted_high (conf 0.90), otherwise it is informational on review.
UNIQUE_MUNI.en: This erf number occurs only once in this municipality, both on the map and in the roll.
UNIQUE_MUNI.af: Hierdie erfnommer kom net een keer in hierdie munisipaliteit voor, op die kaart sowel as in die rol.

accepted_high.en: Verified: town, erf number and other checks tie this roll entry to this parcel.
accepted_high.af: Geverifieer: dorp, erfnommer en ander kontroles koppel hierdie rolinskrywing aan hierdie erf.

accepted_group.en: Verified scheme: these sectional-title units stand on this parcel; the list may be incomplete.
accepted_group.af: Geverifieerde skema: hierdie deeltiteleenhede staan op hierdie erf; die lys is dalk onvolledig.

review.en: Possible match only: the erf number fits, but the town could not be confirmed.
review.af: Slegs 'n moontlike ooreenkoms: die erfnommer pas, maar die dorp kon nie bevestig word nie.

ambiguous.en: Several roll entries fit this erf number equally well; none could be confirmed.
ambiguous.af: Verskeie rolinskrywings pas ewe goed by hierdie erfnommer; geeneen kon bevestig word nie.

not_in_roll.en: Checked: the roll covers this town but has no entry for this erf.
not_in_roll.af: Nagegaan: die rol dek hierdie dorp, maar het geen inskrywing vir hierdie erf nie.

abstain.en: Not linked: the evidence is missing or conflicting, so no entry is shown as this parcel's valuation.
abstain.af: Nie gekoppel nie: die bewyse ontbreek of is teenstrydig, dus word geen inskrywing as hierdie erf se waardasie gewys nie.

missing.en: This parcel is not in the current data build; no valuation is shown rather than a guess.
missing.af: Hierdie erf is nie in die huidige datastel nie; ons wys eerder niks as om te raai.
